rawInput.answer: Application-level route handling is wired up in lib/application.js: app.handle() delegates to a lazily-created `this.router` instance (defined via Object.defineProperty around line 61-81), and app.use()/app.route()/app.param()/app.VERB() are thin proxies to that router's methods. However, the router itself is NOT implemented in this repo — it's the separate `router` npm package (require('router') at lib/application.js:27, declared as a dependency "router": "^2.2.0" in package.json), so expressjs/express only wires it in rather than implementing routing logic.
